plugins.name: carsxe
plugins.description: CarsXE vehicle data APIs — decode VINs, look up license plates, get market values, history, recalls (VIN, YMM, or batch), YMM options, ownership, lien and theft, OBD codes, and more.

skills.name: international-vin
skills.description: Decode an international (non-US) VIN using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user provides a VIN from a European, Asian, or other non-US vehicle and wants to decode it.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API解码欧洲、亚洲等非美国车辆的国际VIN，解析用户提供的车辆识别码。

skills.name: lien-theft
skills.description: Check for active liens and theft records on a vehicle by VIN using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user asks whether a car has a lien, is stolen, or wants to verify ownership is clean before buying.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按VIN检查有效留置权及盗窃记录，用于购车前核对车辆所有权是否无负担。

skills.name: market-value
skills.description: Get the current market value of a vehicle from its VIN using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user asks how much a car is worth, wants to know its value, or is thinking about buying/selling a vehicle.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按VIN获取车辆当前市场价值，用于估值或买卖前了解价格。

skills.name: obd-decoder
skills.description: Decode an OBD-II diagnostic trouble code (DTC) using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user mentions a check engine light code, DTC, or OBD code like P0300, C1234, B0001, or U0100.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API解码OBD-II诊断故障码，包括发动机故障灯相关P/C/B/U类DTC。

skills.name: ownership
skills.description: Look up registered vehicle owners and residents using the CarsXE Ownership API (Enterprise). Use this when the user asks who owns a VIN, who lives at an address, contact details for a named person, or people in a ZIP. Do not use for lien/theft checks.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE企业版Ownership API查询已登记车主或住户，包括VIN所有者、地址住户、具名人员联系方式及邮区人员；不用于留置权或盗窃检查。

skills.name: plate-decoder
skills.description: Look up vehicle information from a license plate number using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user mentions a license plate and wants to know what vehicle it belongs to.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按车牌号码查询对应车辆信息。

skills.name: plate-image-recognition
skills.description: Extract a license plate number from an image URL using the CarsXE Plate Recognition API. Use this when a user shares a photo of a vehicle or license plate and wants to identify the plate number.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE车牌识别API从车辆或车牌图片URL提取车牌号码。

skills.name: recalls-batch
skills.description: Submit and retrieve bulk safety-recall checks for many VINs using the CarsXE Recalls Batch API. Use this when the user wants to check recalls for a fleet, inventory list, CSV of VINs, or more than a handful of vehicles at once.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE Recalls Batch API提交和读取批量VIN安全召回检查，用于车队、库存CSV或多辆车。

skills.name: recalls-ymm
skills.description: Check safety recalls by year, make, and model (no VIN) using the CarsXE Recalls by YMM API. Use this when the user asks about recalls for a model line, or has year/make/model but no VIN.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE按年份品牌型号查询安全召回，适用于没有VIN的车型系列检查。

skills.name: vehicle-history
skills.description: Retrieve a vehicle history report from a VIN using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user wants to know a car's history — past owners, accidents, title status, odometer readings, or whether it's been in a crash.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按VIN获取车辆历史报告，了解前任车主、事故、产权状态和里程等。

skills.name: vehicle-images
skills.description: Retrieve images of a vehicle by make, model, and year using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user wants to see what a vehicle looks like or asks for photos of a specific car.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按品牌型号年份获取车辆图片，查看指定车辆外观。

skills.name: vehicle-recalls
skills.description: Check for open safety recalls on a vehicle using the CarsXE API. Use this when a user asks whether a car has any recalls, safety issues, or wants to know if their vehicle needs a recall repair.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API检查车辆尚未处理的安全召回和是否需要召回维修。

skills.name: vehicle-specs
skills.description: Fetch full vehicle specifications from a VIN using the CarsXE API. Use this when the user provides a VIN and wants to know details about a vehicle (make, model, year, engine, trim, equipment, etc.).
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE API按VIN获取完整车辆规格，包括品牌型号年份、发动机、配置和装备。

skills.name: vin-ocr
skills.description: Extract a VIN from a photo or image URL using the CarsXE VIN OCR API. Use this when a user shares an image of a vehicle or VIN plate and wants to identify the VIN.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE VIN OCR API从照片或图片URL提取车辆识别码。

skills.name: year-make-model
skills.description: Look up vehicle data by Year, Make, and Model using the CarsXE YMM API. Use this when a user doesn't have a VIN but knows the year, make, and model of a vehicle and wants specs, trims, or features.
skills.description_zh: 在没有VIN但已知年份品牌型号时，通过CarsXE YMM API查询规格、配置版本与功能。

skills.name: ymm-options
skills.description: List year, make, model, trim, or variant options for cascading vehicle dropdowns using the CarsXE YMM Options API. Use this when the user wants available years, makes, models, trims, or which years a vehicle was sold — not full specs.
skills.description_zh: 通过CarsXE YMM Options API列举级联车辆选择器的年份、品牌、型号、配置和变体选项，或查询车型销售年份；不获取完整规格。
